commit_note: HEAD at which the gates below ran; f966f976 only changes test artefact selection

binary.provenance: the shipped binary built by the repository's own Docker path, not a harness-only CLI

model_artifact.name: Qwen3.8-27B-NPU2
model_artifact.note: measured from the artifact itself; the earlier 851 tensors / 19.15 GB figure is superseded by this count

routes.layer_major: automatic: routed-expert sets keep it; dense sets keep their prior layer-major behaviour UNLESS the manifest marks the block loop as preferred; OFLM_OPEN_LAYER_MAJOR overrides either way (1 forces it where capable, 0 forces it off, unset leaves this rule)
routes.why: layer-major pads a tail to TOT = B*T whole blocks while the block loop steps it; that padding is the entire measured difference (1.80x at 264 engine tokens, parity at an exact multiple)

layer_major_policy.meaning_of_block_loop_preferred: the manifest asserts that the block loop was MEASURED to be the better dense schedule for this exact geometry; it is not a request to use layer-major

routed_experts.why: one expert pass a layer instead of one per 256-token block

dense.why: layer-major pads the tail to whole blocks and amortises nothing without routed experts

layer_major_policy.capability_is_separate: layer_major_ok() decides whether the schedule can RUN; it ignores OFLM_OPEN_LAYER_MAJOR, so a force cannot claim a route the set has no kernels for

operator_override.nonzero: layer-major on wherever layer_major_ok() is true

qwen38_27b.note: the manifest of this kernel set declares it, which is why the dense default here is the block loop

prefill.gate: 31.F cheap baseline; TTFT excludes nothing, it is the whole time to first token

decode.gate: 31.E; load and prefill are outside the interval
decode.note: decode_tok_s is the loop rate; the runner's own end-to-end rate is a different denominator and the two are never interchanged

context.kv_layout: 4 bf16 planes per full layer: [K hi, K lo, V hi, V lo]; kv_row = 8192
context.levels_never_collapsed: a capacity PASS is not an end-to-end claim

generation_headroom.cli_chat_turn: steps no preamble, so its limit is ctx_len - 1
generation_headroom.refusal: explicit, before the first preamble step; HTTP 400 'Max length reached!' over the API

gates.3_prefill_to_decode_oracle: PASS 16/16, min cosine 0.999999812, max_abs 6.914e-03, no new tolerance
gates.5_normal_serve: PASS, and the over-limit request is HTTP 400 model_error, not Internal error
gates.31G_artifact: PASS 947 tensors, 19844633616 B, no embedded metadata
gates.31J_full_regression: PASS 2350 passed, 172 skipped, 0 failed; settings CI OK
